_meta.purpose: One record per source artefact. independence_group exists so that two sources drawing on the same underlying data are never counted as independent corroboration.
_meta.licence_note: licence describes what we may redistribute. 'cc-by-4.0' permits committing extracted tables with attribution. 'all-rights-reserved' means we cite individual figures under fair quotation but do not commit bulk tables.

obrist-2004-canary.recorder_model: Pettersson D980 bat detector into a voltage amplifier and a ComputerBoards PC-CARD-DAS16/330 acquisition card in an Apple Macintosh PowerBook
obrist-2004-canary.analysis_software: Canary (Cornell), high-resolution spectrograms at 0.6 kHz resolution with 87.5% window overlap
obrist-2004-canary.frequency_definition: frequency of main energy, manually extracted from the spectrogram
obrist-2004-canary.notes: Signals were cut into a fixed 26 ms window (8192 samples), which truncates calls longer than that; the methods name Rhinolophidae as the family this affects, and Table 1 marks affected values in italics. Calls were delimited to the range of probable search calls, so take-off calls were excluded. Most recordings were made after hand release, which the authors say produces calls differing from later search flight and 'leaves some insecurity regarding the population variance'.

denzinger-2001-field.notes: Only the abstract was available. Every method field is therefore genuinely unknown rather than merely unrecorded, which is why the durations from this source carry quality_flag=definition_unstated.

castro-2024-unstated.notes: A comparative compilation, not a study with one method: the values are collated from many original sources via Collen 2012, so no single recording or analysis method applies. Every field is therefore genuinely unstated, which is what places these entries at density 'minimal'. Values from this source should lose to any direct measurement with a stated method.

goerlitz-2010-array.notes: Source levels are defined in the text as 'the call amplitude 10 cm away from the bat's mouth' and reported in dB peSPL. Both the 0.1 m reference distance and the peak-equivalent basis are essential: comparing these values directly with rms-at-1-m figures understates the difference by roughly 20 dB of spreading loss plus the peak-to-rms offset.

seibert-2015-array.recorder_model: 16-channel Knowles microphone arrays (4x4 m square and 6 m vertical chain), custom amplifiers, National Instruments acquisition, 16-bit
seibert-2015-array.analysis_software: custom MATLAB scripts; Sonarbeam for beam reconstruction
seibert-2015-array.notes: Reports both apparent source level (assuming the bat is on axis) and absolute source level (corrected for beam direction). Only the absolute value is stored as source_level; the apparent value is recorded in the row notes.

collen-2012-sonobat.recorder_model: many; EchoBank aggregates recordings contributed by numerous researchers using different detectors and recorders (thesis Table 2.3)
collen-2012-sonobat.frequency_definition: frequency with the maximum energy (amplitude) in the harmonic with the maximum energy (thesis Table 2.8)
collen-2012-sonobat.notes: Parameters were taken by SonoBat from digitised recordings held in the EchoBank call consortium, so there is no single recording method: the compilation spans many contributors and devices. Bandwidth, call duration, maximum frequency and minimum frequency are all defined on the harmonic with the maximum energy, which makes them internally consistent but not necessarily comparable with studies that measure the fundamental. Appendix F distinguishes measured, assumed and imputed values by typeface; only measured (roman) values are imported here.

arias-aguilar-2018-compiled.notes: A comparative synthesis; no single recording method applies.

arevalo-cortes-2024-em3.notes: Free-flying recordings; five search-phase pulses selected from each of ten sequences per species.

ugarte-nunez-2020-unstated.notes: The supplied worksheet gives Table 1 values and pulse counts but not a method extract.

yoh-2020-release.notes: Calls were recorded 5–10 m after hand release; this is retained as hand-release, not free flight.

jung-2014-free-flight.notes: Free-flight values across a multi-country, ten-year study.

szewczak-western-2024-library.notes: The displayed means are for the species-discriminating subset, not all calls in the library.

szewczak-eastern-2022-library.notes: The displayed means are for the species-discriminating subset, not all calls in the library.

yanten-2023-field.recorder_model: SM4 FS with SMM-U1 microphone (passive) and Echo Meter Touch 2 Pro (active)
yanten-2023-field.frequency_definition: second harmonic, selected pulse with the best signal-to-noise ratio
yanten-2023-field.notes: Spectrogram overlap 80%; the paper measured the second harmonic because it held most call energy. The authors analysed search and approach pulses from passive and active field recordings, not identified captive bats.

buitrago-castano-2025-flight-room.frequency_definition: FME is frequency of maximum energy; definitions of the remaining Table 1 measures are unstated
buitrago-castano-2025-flight-room.notes: One adult female voucher (IAvH-M-11214) was recorded in a 13 x 7 x 2 m flight enclosure. Table 1 reports 92 calls / 6 recording sessions; the paper cautions that this does not represent between-individual variation.

orozco-lugo-2013-search.recorder_model: Pettersson Elektronik D980 time-expansion detector (10x) and Sony Walkman Professional WM-D6C recorder with Type II metal tape
orozco-lugo-2013-search.notes: The paper measured search-phase pulses. It reports one six-pulse Eumops underwoodi sequence; the displayed c. 20 ms is its long CF component, so duration is retained as approximate rather than as a directly comparable whole-pulse mean.

lopez-baucells-2018-field.recorder_model: unstated in the checked Results/Table 4 extract
lopez-baucells-2018-field.analysis_software: unstated in the checked Results/Table 4 extract
lopez-baucells-2018-field.frequency_definition: peak frequency; analytical definition unstated in the checked extract
lopez-baucells-2018-field.notes: Free-flight context and full recording-method fields need a second check against the source PDF; this record retains only the explicitly stated peak-frequency value and observed range.

kofoky-2009-mixed.recorder_model: Pettersson D980 time-expansion detector and Sony digital recorder
kofoky-2009-mixed.frequency_definition: FmaxE: frequency containing maximum energy, measured from power spectrograms; Fmin/Fmax/duration/IPI measured from sonograms
kofoky-2009-mixed.notes: Table 1 pools recordings made during hand release, on zip lines, in flight cages, and at roost exits. The source does not provide one recording condition per tabulated taxon, so the imported observations honestly retain recording_condition=unspecified.

monadjem-2011-anabat.frequency_definition: Table 2 labels Fmin, Fmax, Fc and Fk; their detailed operational definitions are unstated in the source text checked.
monadjem-2011-anabat.notes: Calls were recorded from captured bats released after measurement. The paper identifies distinct low- and high-frequency Nycteris arge sequences as possible harmonics, which are stored as separate variants rather than combined.

grunwald-2024-full-spectrum.recorder_model: full-spectrum bat detectors (model unstated in Table 4 extract)
grunwald-2024-full-spectrum.frequency_definition: Fppeak is the frequency with the highest energy; Fmin/Fmax are estimated signal-frequency bounds
grunwald-2024-full-spectrum.notes: Table 4 reports means, SDs and observed ranges across surveys in 2019 and 2022. These imports retain only means and SDs, with the published ranges in verbatim source notes available for later expansion.

ing-2016-array.recorder_model: 3D acoustic tracking system (detailed hardware not stated in Table 2 extract)
ing-2016-array.notes: Table 2 reports 52 calls, 26 of each alternating type. Calls were recorded around releases and captures, so condition is retained as unspecified rather than mislabeled as normal search flight.

webala-2019-full-spectrum.recorder_model: Pettersson D500X and D1000X real-time full-spectrum bat detectors
webala-2019-full-spectrum.frequency_definition: Fmax is the peak frequency of the constant-frequency component, measured using power-spectrum analysis
webala-2019-full-spectrum.notes: Table 2 gives means or ranges of sequence means; its N is individuals and n is total sequences. Hand-held, flight-cage, resting and free-flying conditions are retained in the observation label and notes; only free-flying wild is assigned that standardized condition.

goodman-2011-flight-cage.frequency_definition: PF is peak frequency; Fmax and Fmin are maximum and minimum frequency
goodman-2011-flight-cage.notes: Table 4 reports calls recorded inside flight cages, with mean, SD and observed minimum–maximum. This controlled condition is retained as unspecified rather than conflated with free-flying wild search calls.

bakwo-fils-2018-anabat.frequency_definition: Fmax/Fmin are call frequency bounds; Fk is frequency at the knee and Fc is characteristic frequency
bakwo-fils-2018-anabat.notes: Calls were recorded after hand release, with the detector held at bat height and the observer about 20 m from release. The authors selected a late search-phase call in each sequence; this release context is retained explicitly.

patterson-2025-handheld.frequency_definition: frequency of maximum energy; bandwidth is source-reported call bandwidth
patterson-2025-handheld.duration_threshold_db: threshold 16 for Mozambique recordings; otherwise unstated
patterson-2025-handheld.notes: The Table 4 comparisons are genetically resolved taxa. Calls were recorded from bats held in hand; this condition is retained rather than treated as normal free flight. No source bytes could be cached from the public download route.

taylor-boyd-2025-release.recorder_model: BatBox Baton XD with R05 recorder, Batlogger M, Pettersson D240x, Anabat Walkabout, Echo Meter Touch 2, or Echo Meter Touch 2 Pro
taylor-boyd-2025-release.frequency_definition: source-defined Frequency of Maximum Power is the frequency of maximum amplitude; characteristic, knee, sweep and bandwidth measures are SonoBat parameters as tabulated
taylor-boyd-2025-release.notes: Captured bats were recorded on release, with the detector approximately two metres away. The analysis retained calls with SonoBat quality >0.8 and sequences of 10-32 pulses, specifically to reduce deviation from search-phase parameters. The exact release context is retained and not represented as free-flying-wild search calls.

taylor-2024-escarpment-passive.frequency_definition: peak frequency; the article separately states that Table S9 includes characteristic, minimum, and maximum frequencies and duration, but does not give an operational definition of peak frequency in the text checked
taylor-2024-escarpment-passive.notes: Passive recordings were made at five apple farms between Warden and Fouriesburg, Golden Gate Highlands National Park, and Witsieshoek Community Conservation Area in the eastern Free State. High signal-to-noise sequences were analysed. The reported n=50 and n=49 sum to the 99 passive call sequences stated for R. acrotis and R. cervenyi; it is recorded as n_calls rather than number of individuals.

monadjem-2020-nycteris-woodi-literature.recorder_model: unstated in the checked species account
monadjem-2020-nycteris-woodi-literature.analysis_software: unstated in the checked species account

monadjem-2020-nycteris-woodi-literature.notes: A secondary species account reporting Fenton and Bell (1981), with Fenton and Thomas (1980) also cited. No recording condition, locality, instrument, or analysis protocol was provided in the checked account; this is intentionally a definition-un-stated literature summary, not an inferred free-flight measurement.

maluleke-2017-damarensis-handheld.frequency_definition: resting frequency is the peak frequency (maximum amplitude) of the stable constant-frequency component
maluleke-2017-damarensis-handheld.notes: Calls were recorded from hand-held bats positioned 10 cm in front of the microphone. This use of resting frequency avoids flight Doppler-shift variation; it is retained as an unspecified recording condition, not free flight.

tanshi-2021-nigeria-captured.notes: The article states it recorded echolocation calls of captured individuals to create a national call library. gomeh-djame-2026-lobeke-unstated.notes: The source says calls are known only from the paratype. It provides call-parameter values but not a record-level collection or recording protocol in the checked section.

patterson-2018-otomops-release.frequency_definition: peak frequency is frequency with maximum energy; maximum frequency is StartF and minimum frequency is EndF

Ten high-SNR calls per bat were chosen only after the gradual post-release change had ceased, i.e. in search-phase mode. The paper's taxa were supported by molecular analyses, but the released and acoustically recorded individuals were not the preserved genetic vouchers.

eurobatrait-2023-compiled.recorder_model: many; EuroBaTrait compiles published studies, monitoring programmes and expert contributions

lopez-bosch-2021-china-compiled.recorder_model: varies by underlying study; every table-row detector is retained in the row note

lopez-bosch-2021-china-compiled.duration_threshold_db: varies or unstated across underlying studies
lopez-bosch-2021-china-compiled.notes: This is a secondary compilation method record. It intentionally does not collapse its source-specific detector, sex, context, or region fields into one fictional protocol; those details remain in each imported row's note.

al-obaid-2026-saudi-anabat.frequency_definition: Table headings SF, EF and Fmax; the article describes Fmax as the reported frequency maximum, with detailed operational definition unstated in accessible text
al-obaid-2026-saudi-anabat.notes: Recordings were made 2021-2024 at 29 Saudi localities. The source says bats were visually identified after capture while flying/emerging. It distinguishes released/free-ranging observations from hand-release inside a closed room; when table rows cannot be securely linked to one condition, recording_condition remains unspecified.

pham-2021-vietnam-tent-and-free-flight.recorder_model: Wildlife Acoustics SM4-Bat ultrasonic recorder with U2 microphone
pham-2021-vietnam-tent-and-free-flight.analysis_software: Avisoft SasLab Pro; FFT size 1024, frame size 100%, Hann window
pham-2021-vietnam-tent-and-free-flight.frequency_definition: FMAXE is frequency of maximum energy; hf/lf are highest/lowest frequency across the call; sf/tf are peak frequency at the call onset/end
pham-2021-vietnam-tent-and-free-flight.notes: Bats were recorded flying singly in a 2 x 4 x 2 m tent, with additional free-flying recordings at capture sites. Table 2 gives a species-level summary but does not identify which recording condition produced each value, so its rows remain unspecified.

jennings-2004-release.recorder_model: Ultra Sound Advice S-25 bat detector into an Ultra Sound Advice Portable Ultrasound Processor (2.2 s time-expansion buffer, 448 kHz, 8-bit), replayed at 1/10 speed to a Sony WM-D6C cassette recorder
jennings-2004-release.microphone: Ultra Sound Advice S-25 microphone, 20-120 kHz (+/- 3 dB)
jennings-2004-release.analysis_software: BatSound v3.3 (Pettersson Elektronik), redigitised at 44.1 kHz / 16-bit; effective bit depth 8
jennings-2004-release.frequency_definition: peak frequency = frequency of maximum energy in an interpolated (95%) 1024-point power spectrum; start and end frequencies read from a spectrogram of the harmonic with most energy. Frequency resolution 488 Hz.
jennings-2004-release.duration_threshold_db: onset of the signal to decay into background noise, read from the oscillogram
jennings-2004-release.notes: Each bat was released from the hand in background-cluttered space about 10 m from the recorder and recorded as it flew freely, so values are hand-release, not free-flying wild. One call per individual was analysed, chosen from the last calls of the sequence and judged to be an orientation-phase call. The authors note that calls recorded this way may not be typical of species that normally forage in open space. Measurements were taken from the harmonic containing most energy, which is recorded per row.

barataud-2013-guyane-unstated.notes: Barataud's own acoustic-ecology method, using heterodyne and time-expansion listening; the archive did not carry the equipment detail. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

mcarthur-2021-borneo-unstated.notes: 508 individuals, mean and SD reported per species in Table 1. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

pennay-lavery-2017-solomons-unstated.notes: Regional identification guide; Table 16 gives seven parameters per species or form. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

monadjem-2017-swaziland-release.notes: 178 calls from 145 hand-released individuals, 2005-2016. Detection distances were measured alongside the call parameters. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

dalhoumi-2023-tunisia-passive.notes: Passive recording with Batlogger M and Song Meter SM2 detectors at eight desert sites, so values are free-flying rather than released. Analysis settings are not stated in the archive.

van-de-sijpe-2011-unstated.notes: Free-flying bats in natural conditions; medians stratified by call duration. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

fukui-2015-korea-unstated.notes: 93 individuals and 1,129 pulses; the archive took ranges from the narrative text rather than a table. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

gyorossy-2024-vietnam-unstated.notes: 3,438 pulses from 1,042 recordings held in ChiroVox. Recording method varies across the corpus and is mostly enclosure or hand-held rather than free flight. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

zamora-gutierrez-2020-sonozotz-standardi.notes: A single standardised protocol applied across eight regions of Mexico; the recordings are overwhelmingly hand-release and zip-line rather than free flight. Analysis settings are not stated in the archive.

lung-mv-ffh-factsheets-unstated.notes: Agency factsheets restating Skiba (2009) and Dietz et al. (2007); no method of its own. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

surlykke-2009-array.notes: Multi-microphone array over a pond, wild free-flying bats. Analysis settings are not stated in the archive.

schuchmann-2010-unstated.notes: Five sympatric Rhinolophus in Bulgaria with per-species sample sizes. The archive notes the CF means were in a figure rather than retrievable text. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

rehak-2010-compiled.notes: A compilation of Ahlen 1990, Schober & Grimmberger 1998, Rehak 1999 and Russo & Jones 2002, so there is no single recording method behind these values.

salsamendi-2012-unstated.notes: Sympatric and allopatric CF frequencies for two rhinolophids. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

rydell-arlettaz-1994-unstated.notes: Open-space foraging calls of Tadarida teniotis. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

holderied-2005-videogrammetry.notes: Stereo videogrammetry with a microphone array, which is what makes the source level measurable. Analysis settings are not stated in the archive.

gessinger-2019-unstated.notes: Lonchorhina aurita recorded in flight; the paper's point is that this phyllostomid calls far louder than its family. The consolidated upload archive records the recording context per value but no equipment or analysis settings, so these fields are unstated rather than assumed.

alberdi-garin-2018-compiled.notes: A Mammalian Species account compiling earlier work; no method of its own.

surlykke-2013-trachops-array.notes: Microphone array measuring beam directionality of perching and flying bats. Analysis settings are not stated in the archive.
